test.level: Descriptive measurement agreement and paired bird-level score concordance only; never redefine old 5km result.
metrics: Per day Pearson correlation between daily-median-centered native GPS and barometric height on exact first-selected GPS fixes, then report median across 5,854 days and median of per-bird medians (28 biological birds).
Per bird-day median absolute centered GPS-vs-barometric difference, in meters; report median across bird-days and median of per-bird medians.
Spearman and Pearson correlation of the 27 exactly matched bird-level gain scores obtained previously from each native height modality, count positive-positive and nonpositive-nonpositive birds.
Paired bird bootstrap with 5,000 bird resamples, random seed 20261024, for Spearman and mean difference between native sensor gains; source quality median CI via resampled 28 bird medians.
Spearman association between bird-day median HDOP and median absolute GPS-vs-barometer discrepancy, descriptive only; year-stratified descriptive medians.
Recalculate original two per-sensor 999-draw null distributions from archived null CSV and verify Holm p=0.002 without re-running source event fitting.
test.units: Bird is independent sampling unit for score and CIs; bird-day only descriptive source quality, GPS records are not biological replicates.
test.no_new_positive_criteria: Do not turn postoutcome Spearman/bootstrap into new biology inferential p; do not suggest physical independence based on high correlation.
test.source_outcome_status: Both fixed native GPS and pressure-height source results supported n=27, but are paired within the exact same biological bird and tag. Not two distinct biological-study replications.

external_scientific_checks.method_knowledge: GPS and air-pressure barometric altimetry use different direct sensors, but barometric height uses pressure/weather reference and GPS horizontal context. Barometric pressure sensor is optional for Ornitela tags, device model and calibration of these particular archived records unverified.
issues: Within-50km or 5km microtopography and flight-mode composition can create the same apparent individual signal in both native altitude modalities.
Daily centering removes additive offsets but not heteroscedastic instrument error or tag-specific fluctuations.
Shared GPS x-y positions and time, non-independent weather and pressure calibration can induce correlated errors.

next: Use this audit to constrain the publication claim, then seek original transmitter/manufacturer device-level calibration or genuine negative control from exact stationary geodetic test points before attributing the vertical identity to behavioral specialization.
